# Risk Processes

**AI-generated by:** Alson (A.I Agent)

Use this file for PM-35 through PM-40. RAID records are operational evidence inside the Risk domain, not an eighth performance domain.

| ID | Process | Purpose | Inputs | Outputs | Tailoring | Check | Authority | PMI source |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| PM-35 | Plan Risk Management | Define how uncertainty, threats, opportunities, and responses will be managed. | Governance, scope, schedule, finance, stakeholders, resources, risk appetite | Risk approach, categories, scoring, cadence, thresholds, escalation route | Use a lightweight risk note for low exposure; formal method for critical or complex work. | Ownership, scoring, response authority, review cadence, and escalation thresholds are explicit. | Drafts approach; PM accepts risk controls and tolerances. | 2.7.2.1 |
| PM-36 | Identify Risks | Discover threats and opportunities that may affect objectives. | Plans, assumptions, dependencies, issues, stakeholder input, lessons | Risk register entries, triggers, causes, effects, proposed owners and responses | Revisit at phase, delivery, or material change points. | Each risk has cause, event, effect, source, trigger, exposure, and owner or gap. | Captures risks as Proposed; PM accepts, assigns, or closes. | 2.7.2.2 |
| PM-37 | Perform Risk Analysis | Analyze probability, impact, urgency, and uncertainty. | Risk register, thresholds, estimates, scenarios, data, expert input | Risk analysis, exposure ranking, confidence, treatment priority | Use qualitative analysis by default; add quantitative analysis when decision value justifies it. | Method, assumptions, evidence, confidence, and priority are stated. | Recommends priority; PM decides tolerance and response commitment. | 2.7.2.3 |
| PM-38 | Plan Risk Responses | Select actions for material threats and opportunities. | Risk analysis, risk appetite, options, owners, cost and schedule effects | Response plan, contingency or trigger actions, residual exposure, proposed owners | Match response detail to exposure and response cost. | Response addresses cause or effect, has trigger, timing, owner, and residual exposure. | Prepares response; PM accepts risk treatment and assignment. | 2.7.2.4 |
| PM-39 | Implement Risk Responses | Carry out approved risk actions and record their effect. | Response plan, approvals, action log, triggers, resources | Completed response actions, residual risk, issue proposal if occurred | Use formal tracking for high exposure; integrate low exposure actions into normal work. | Response evidence exists and residual exposure or occurrence is updated. | Performs only authorized actions; PM directs material commitments. | 2.7.2.5 |
| PM-40 | Monitor Risks | Track existing risks, new uncertainty, triggers, responses, and residual exposure. | Risk register, response evidence, status data, changes, assumptions, issues | Updated risk assessment, new risks, response proposals, escalations, lessons | Set cadence by exposure and project change rate. | All material risks have current evidence, status, next trigger, and response path. | May update evidence and propose state; PM directs closure, acceptance, or escalation. | 2.7.2.6 |
